name: Final Fantasy VII

original.title: Final Fantasy VII
original.platform: PC (current Steam release; game first released on PS1 1997, PC 1998)

project.name: FF7Recomp (pcrecomp-style x86 to C, FFNx renderer, 7th Heaven-style mod launcher)

update.channel: GitHub releases (the launcher also checks for updates itself; pref update_checked)

assets.needs: FINAL FANTASY VII (current Steam release, not the 2013 Edition) game files: downloaded by the launcher from the user's Steam account (QR sign-in, ~3.3 GB) or imported from an install folder. The launcher then recompiles ff7_en.exe on the device (once, ~8-10 min).
assets.notes: After an app update, the launcher's 'Update the game' relinks the compiled game.

settings.in_app_menu: Launcher > Settings (Frame rate, Performance, Display aspect, Resolution, Renderer, CRT filter, Screen/second screen, On-screen controls, Controller, boosters). Launcher > FFNx settings for raw FFNx.toml overrides.
settings.summary: Frame rate (Original / fixed / 30 FPS battles / 60 / 120 experimental / 60 with 30 battles), Performance (Cooler/Balanced/Best), Resolution (Auto or 1-4x), aspect (4:3, 16:9, 16:9 stretched), Vulkan or OpenGL ES, CRT filter, bottom-screen companion, booster speed / no encounters / battle enhancement, EXP/AP/Gil multipliers.

controls: Controller support (A confirms, B cancels), any-button swaps in Settings > Controller, keyboard map, on-screen touch controls (Automatic/Always/Off), rumble (None/Light/Strong).
display: Game on the top screen; Thor bottom screen shows party status, location, enemy HP, world map with party position, and a touch deck (menu, save/load state, speed, random battles). Option to swap screens or free the bottom screen for Pixel Guide or other apps.
saves: /sdcard/Android/data/com.ff7recomp/files/game/save (save00.ff7...save09.ff7). Save states in a savestates folder (SaveStates.java). Optional Steam Cloud sync (cloud_saves).
notes: Mods from the 7th Heaven catalogs go in files/mods. FFNx.toml is regenerated from FFNx.template.toml before every start, so edit the launcher prefs, not the toml. Project states it was written with Claude Code and not human-reviewed.
verified: On device: dumpsys, launcher.xml, steam.xml key names only, files/game and build.log tail, sdcard layout. APK: LauncherActivity/GameInstall (pref keys, option labels, FFNx.toml writer). Web: GitHub repo README and releases.
